title: GEMglColorMaterial
description: cause a material color to track the current color

messages.description: faces tracking the color: GL_FRONT, GL_BACK or GL_FRONT_AND_BACK
which of several material parameters track the current color

arguments.description: faces tracking the color: GL_FRONT, GL_BACK or GL_FRONT_AND_BACK
which of several material parameters track the current color

body: [GEMglColorMaterial] calls glColorMaterial() each time a gemlist passes through it, with the parameters set by its creation arguments and inlets. Its creation arguments also take GL constants by name; its inlets only take their values. See glColorMaterial in the OpenGL reference.
